# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Next, locate the water-quality test results.
3. Confirm the date of the results with the inspectors.
4. If a failure is noted, make a separate entry to describe the severity of the failure.
5. If additional action is needed after a follow-up inspection after a 10 day, make a note to archive the inspection document after final dispositions.
